definitions.grasp: Actual tryTackles partial coupling followed by actual updateBond. Powers set to 1e-9 and chance() false; isolates the transition, not ordinary tackle outcomes.
definitions.support: Immediate run disengagement/re-engagement; same pose and time, manually depleted contact-local bases. Demonstrates storage lifetime, not a measured player recovery.
definitions.crossing: Actual stepBody/resolveBodyContacts, fixed free-body geometry over 0.05 seconds. No tackle/controller update; smaller dt is a diagnostic, not a production mode.
definitions.limitations: Synthetic counterfactuals prove representational/solver gaps, not their frequency in games or attribution of the prior NFL-stat regressions. Not NFL validation.

normalization: Text logs have leading/final blank lines and trailing whitespace removed; output retained.
